name: castle-kit
summary:
Castle: long red-terracotta range (y0..9, corbel table, dark slate gables) with nine towers: crenellated square North Tower over an arched porch and oriel, the Flag Tower beside it rising to y19, an east octagonal tower, and slate spires on the west pair, wings and south octagonal pair.
Arts and Industries: a brick Greek cross in a square with yellow and blue bands, four gabled entrance naves with twin towers and an octagonal rotunda with drum and lantern. Freer: a low white-terracotta palazzo round a court, with a three-arch north loggia and a grey hip roof.
Hirshhorn: a beige drum (y3..10) on four curved piers with a dark glass band round the court and one balcony slot facing north. Silhouette, colour and these signature features are what make each one readable from the air. Four-plot South Mall kit built from the architect's masses. The Castle's nine-tower jagged slate silhouette (Flag Tower tallest) is the hero, with the polychrome Arts & Industries cross, the low Freer palazzo and the raised Hirshhorn drum beside it. Exterior only: hollow interiors, shroomlight glow behind glass, lanterns and uplights at the bases. (7 of 7 parts finished)
